# The Pragmatic Programmer

By Hunt and Thomas.

Some chapters repeat the same point with new stories. The main argument is that small habits compound over years. A good book for a long flight.

The middle part drags, the last third makes up for it. It changed how I run the weekly review. Worth rereading in a year, especially the chapter on planning.

I would give it four stars out of five. Iris recommended it after our conversation about focus. The author uses many case studies, some feel cherry-picked.

Lent my copy to David, ask for it back in Wednesday meeting.
